newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest estimate trimmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest estimate trimmed.

text.p: -- Brown Brothers Harriman analyst Raphael Soifer said he cut the 1997 earnings estimate for National Westminster Bank Plc to 73 pence per share from 74 pence
-- The analyst said the reduction reflected the bank's upward revison to 90 million pounds of the amount by which revenues had been overstated through a mispricing of interest rate derivatives.
-- The analyst had previously reduced his 1997 estimate by two pence after the original announcement of a 50 million pound charge
-- Analyst's 1998 estimate of 86 pence is unchanged
